title: Uruguayan Fluffy Pudding Dessert
description: A unique Uruguayan-inspired dessert made with fluffy, yellow pudding, perfect for a sweet treat.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the Fluffy Pudding Mix, yellow food coloring, granulated sugar, and unsalted butter. Mix until smooth and creamy.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the large eggs and vanilla extract.
Add the egg mixture to the pudding mixture and mix until well combined.
In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 1/4 cup of cold water and let it soften for 5 minutes.
Add the softened gelatin to the pudding mixture and mix until dissolved.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Refrigerate for at least 3 hours or until set.
